thesis: Ball Lightning compresses six trampling damage into a three-mana creature that disappears at end of turn, making red’s temporary power philosophy literal.

competitiveTimeline.significance: Ball Lightning became one of red’s signature rares, influencing decades of hasty sacrifice creatures and establishing a benchmark for burst damage attached to a body.

playbook.role: Cast it when blockers are absent, tapped, or too small to absorb the trample damage, and pair it with burn that clears the path or finishes the opponent after the attack.
